search_inventory.architecture: Product-only path: Preview QR decode -> first-colon strict v1 parse -> exact QIUQIU/DHEA family match -> attempt/session-bound shutter gate -> immutable JPEG capture -> declaration contract -> Core final-JPEG product-family recheck. Geometry path: G1/G1-D physical references -> G2/G2-D design -> G3E/G3-D tools -> G4/G5 validation -> R/C/A/G6 authoritative ROI. Shared contract semantics may connect the paths; geometry completion must not.
search_inventory.report:
## CURRENT_REVISION_CANDIDATE

- `herdr-team/.agent-control/MASTER_PLAN.md:325+` (Formal QR product identification scope correction): before, prior plans could be read as one QR program; after, `QR_PRODUCT_IDENTIFICATION_DEPENDENCY=REMOVED` for 72 images, 48-hour relabel, G2/G3E, window ground truth, Homography and ROI thresholds. Recommendation: use this as controlling interpretation; product-only tasks depend on shared QR/declaration semantics and lifecycle evidence, not geometry.
- `herdr-team/.agent-control/TASK_BOARD.md:295-299`: before, QR-PLAN-04 was the latest combined baseline; after, QR-SCOPE-05 expressly limits G5->C1->A1 and G1-D->G2-D->G3-D to geometry/research scope. Recommendation: candidate/checks should quote this boundary and leave business execution `NO`.
- `docs/QiuQiu_DHEA_Capture_Product_Gate_End_to_End_Spec_v1.7_IMPLEMENTATION_BASELINE.md:101-140,250-352,366-373`: product family semantics, shutter gate, strict parse and state machine contain no 72/48h/G5 requirement. Classification: `NO_DEPENDENCY`; preserve behavior and explicitly state geometry-independent eligibility.
- Same file `:444-467,499-518`: declaration and session/attempt binding are product-contract concerns. Classification: `NO_DEPENDENCY`; only migration acceptance/runtime cutover remains separately gated.
- Same file `:724-733`: old mapping says G5-v2 -> C1 and C1+R4 -> A1 -> A2. Before interpretation: all C1 contract synchronization could transitively wait on G5. After: retain this edge only for full ROI/registry/policy migration; remove it from product declaration and product recheck candidates. Classification: `CURRENT_REVISION_CANDIDATE`.
- Same file `:873-880`: `PRODUCT_IDENTIFICATION` is final-JPEG QR/protocol/product/Registry binding, separate from `WINDOW_LOCALIZATION`. Classification: `NO_DEPENDENCY` for QR/protocol/product; Registry fields tied to authoritative ROI policy must remain nullable/separately gated.
- Same file `:941-947`: Lab Upload requires final-JPEG QR recheck and product-family match, with no geometry precondition. Classification: `NO_DEPENDENCY`; preserve.
- Same file `:1017-1025`: ten-point release conjunction combines G4/G5/G6/C1/R4/A1/A2 with `FINAL_JPEG_QR_PRODUCT_AND_DIRECTION_CONFIRMED`. Before: can imply final-JPEG product confirmation itself requires geometry. After: the conjunction remains valid only for ten-point/full measurement release; split product-family recheck from direction/ROI release. Classification: `CURRENT_REVISION_CANDIDATE`.
- `docs/requirements/INDEX.md:78-90` and `docs/specs/INDEX.md:15-22`: indexes still expose the combined v1.7 candidate and stale `PENDING_REVIEW` labels despite external acceptance. Classification: `CURRENT_REVISION_CANDIDATE`, but not writable in this assignment; Main should list them for later authorized sync.

- `herdr-team/.agent-control/EVIDENCE/QR-PLAN-04-D01-checks.json:24-50`: records what QR-PLAN-04 reviewed, including 72/48h and G5->C1. Preserve as historical review evidence; new candidate should supersede interpretation prospectively, not rewrite it.

## UNKNOWN_OWNERSHIP

- `herdr-team/.agent-control/DECISIONS.md:8-9` and PM scope ruling: existing v3 work is protected; adoption and authorship were not established. Classification: `UNKNOWN_OWNERSHIP`; product candidates may cite contracts read-only but must not assign existing business files.
- `docs/.../09_MANUAL_QR_CONTROLLED_ROI_PLAN_REVISION_v1.0.md:116-125`: API/App/Core paths have only future proposed owners. Classification: `UNKNOWN_OWNERSHIP`; Main should report exact paths and propose ownership, never claim grants.
- `herdr-team/.agent-control/FILE_OWNERSHIP.md:213-222`: only candidate/checks outputs are ACTIVE; no product business file ownership exists. This confirms all three product implementation candidates remain proposal-only.

## NO_DEPENDENCY

- `docs/api/dhea-v3-product-gate.md:1-31`: Schema/SHA/declaration preacceptance has no geometry prerequisite. Its blocker is API-02/runtime adoption, not G5.
- v1.7 `:272-289`: shutter enablement depends on camera/storage/capture state and matching evidence bound to current session/attempt; geometry quality is explicitly excluded from hard gate.
- v1.7 `:329-352`: length validation, first-colon split, exact namespace/product and byte hash are pure protocol behavior.
- v1.7 `:366-373`: Decode->Parse->Product Family Match->shutter transition is direct and geometry-free.
- Package04 `:27`: explicitly says App gate is outside the geometry minimal slice. This is positive evidence against importing geometry prerequisites.
- Package10 `:82-86`: App/API/Core are outside G1-D/G2-D/G3-D. This is positive evidence against the 72/48h transitive edge.

## Actual problematic edges

1. `72/48h -> G1-D -> G2-D -> G3-D` was documented for geometry. A broad “QR implementation” reading could incorrectly make preview decode/product match wait on this branch.
2. `G1-v2 -> G2-v2 -> G3-v2 -> G4-v2 -> G5-v2 -> C1` made the monolithic C1 migration wait on geometry.
3. C1 bundled Bundle1.6/v3, App Product Gate, declaration binding, final-JPEG QR evidence and authoritative ROI (`05...md:18-23`). That bundling propagated G5 transitively into otherwise geometry-free product contract work.
4. v1.7’s ten-point conjunction (`:1017-1025`) mixed product-family confirmation with direction/ROI/measurement release. It is valid as a final full-release gate, invalid as the prerequisite list for final-JPEG product recheck itself.

Recommended documentary cut: split C1 by responsibility. Product declaration/API contract and final-JPEG product-family recheck may proceed through separate candidates after their own Review/PM authorization. Keep C1-ROI/registry/policy behind G5/R4/A1/A2/G6. Keep final-JPEG direction/association checks behind the geometry evidence they genuinely consume; do not conflate those with QR decode/protocol/product-family verification.

## Coverage and uncertainty

Searched `docs/` plus control `MASTER_PLAN`, `FILE_OWNERSHIP`, `TASK_BOARD`, `DECISIONS`, `BLOCKERS`, `ROUNDS`, and all historical `EVIDENCE` for `72`, `48h`, geometry/Homography/ROI, G5, Decode, Parse, Product Match/Identification, Shutter, final JPEG, C1, v1.7 and package04/09/10. Read full relevant sections rather than isolated hits. No direct sentence was found saying Decode or Parse requires 72/48h/G5; the defect is transitive through monolithic C1 and combined release wording. Existing business-file ownership for the three proposed product slices remains unknown/ungranted. No files were written and no validation commands were run.

implementation_inventory.description: Frozen authority requires three independent candidates; product-only semantics are exact: background CameraX QR_CODE, first-colon parsing, exact 1:QIUQIU:DHEA, SHA of actual decoded UTF-8 bytes, shutter blocked before match, session/camera-session/attempt/verification bindings, invalidation boundaries, and separate unreadable/malformed/version/mismatch states. It also forbids geometry/ROI/Homography/measurement/quantification integration.

Current QR-SCOPE-05 ownership grants only two documentary output paths to lfa-start(w15:p1): candidate.md and checks.json. It explicitly says no business/source edits, no new active business ownership, and all QR decode/parse/match/shutter/final-JPEG permissions remain NO. Therefore every proposed Android/Core/gateway/schema/fixture path below is UNKNOWN for existing WRITE_OWNER unless otherwise registered elsewhere; do not infer an owner from module names.
Existing CameraX fields: Preview, ImageCapture, ImageAnalysis, Camera, PreviewView, camera/torch observers.

startCamera binds Preview, ImageCapture and ImageAnalysis in one UseCaseGroup sharing PreviewView viewport; observes CameraState and calls onCameraReady; generation invalidates stale camera callbacks; initial focus is non-authoritative.

captureRawJpeg uses ImageCapture.takePicture, snapshots session/generation and camera metadata at shutter request, reads immutable JPEG bytes, validates JPEG header, derives geometry evidence, and dispatches success/error only when generation remains current. There is no QR decoder or product gate here.
CaptureScreen owns remembered NativeCameraManager, lot sheet, focus UI, saved notice and lifecycle cleanup.
Current shutter callback invokes ViewModel.onShutterTriggered, then NativeCameraManager.captureRawJpeg and ViewModel.handleRawCapturedBytes.
CameraPreviewContainer creates PreviewView, starts CameraX with PreviewGuidanceAnalyzer, handles tap focus, and has no QR analysis surface.
Shutter UI is enabled solely by !isCapturing && isCameraReady; no product-match prerequisite currently exists.

Ui state already has currentSessionId, isCameraReady, isCapturing, lastCapturedAttemptId/SHA and activeAttemptId, but no cameraSessionId, product verification record, QR state, or product match state.

resetSession rotates currentSessionId; onShutterTriggered rejects busy/reconciling/not-ready/permission-invalid states, creates UUID captureAttemptId and captureBundleId, stores pendingCapture, and sets isCapturing. onCaptureFailed clears pending attempt and isCapturing.
handleRawCapturedBytes claims the pending attempt once, attaches camera metadata/geometry, persists original bytes, records attempt/SHA, and clears isCapturing in finally.

CaptureBundle currently carries session/attempt/bundle IDs, original media/SHA, timing, lot evidence, camera metadata and optional geometry/focus/preview evidence; no product declaration or verification record.
Android has CameraX camera2/core/lifecycle/view dependencies only among camera libraries; no ML Kit barcode/QR or ZXing dependency is present.
Version catalog confirms CameraX 1.5.0 entries and no barcode/QR decoder entry.

Generated v3 CAPTURE_V3 schema already defines product_gate_declaration with session/attempt/verification IDs, fixed product constants, qr protocol/mapping states, actual payload SHA field, and lot_id/serial_id null; product declaration is required.

Generated semantic validator binds declaration session/attempt to capture, shutter times to capture_time_evidence, requires SHA-256 of literal UTF-8 bytes b'1:QIUQIU:DHEA', and checks monotonic ordering.
Generator source defines DECLARATION and CAPTURE structures, including required product fields and null LOT/Serial; this is the source of truth for generated v3 schema.

Generator maps outputs to openapi-dhea-v3.json, six schema files, positive/negative fixtures, qr-cases, generated python_gateway/dhea_v3_schema.py, JCS declaration/metadata/result fixtures, and baseline hashes. Generator is the minimum contract edit point; generated outputs are protected until a future contract task is authorized.
Exported bundle schema already carries capture session/attempt/bundle/original SHA and product_gate_evidence with verification ID, payload SHA, fixed product constants, and null LOT/Serial.

Positive v3 capture fixture demonstrates the current declaration shape and values: session/attempt bindings, verification_record_id, qr_payload_sha256 for 1:QIUQIU:DHEA, lot_id null and serial_id null.
Positive bundle fixture exports the same product gate evidence and identity bindings with null LOT/Serial.

QR fixture cases cover supported payload, unsupported version, URL-not-opened, empty, length boundaries, first-colon-only behavior, and invalid UTF-8; supported hash is the literal 1:QIUQIU:DHEA byte sequence.
Canonical declaration fixture exists and is tied to JCS/hash checks.
JCS fixture hash manifest exists.
Gateway input combines v2 METADATA and CAPTURE_V3, validates v3 declaration semantics, and maps semantic failures to INVALID_PRODUCT_GATE_DECLARATION.
Upload parser validates selected capture schema, idempotency key, original image SHA and JPEG framing.

Active /api/v2/lfa/measure explicitly rejects schema_version dhea-capture/3.0 with V3_ACCEPTANCE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Thus the v3 declaration is implemented as generated/documentary validation surface, not accepted runtime behavior.

DheaRuntime.analyze initializes result with product identity gap evidence and marks implementation_status NOT_IMPLEMENTATION_BASELINE; it accepts image bytes and expected SHA only, with no product declaration input.
Core validates byte SHA/JPEG framing, decodes with Pillow and applies EXIF orientation, then starts WINDOW_LOCALIZATION. There is no final-JPEG QR recheck or product-only recheck.

After decode Core enters geometry localization, perspective transform and ROI support validation. This is precisely the path FINAL_JPEG_QR_PRODUCT_RECHECK must not expand into; no QR product check exists before it.
Diagnostics includes PRODUCT_IDENTIFICATION stage but setup marks PRODUCT_IDENTIFICATION NOT_IMPLEMENTED, alongside other deferred stages.
The active v2 gateway freezes metadata/image, invokes runtime.analyze on the original stored bytes, and persists the result; no declaration/product recheck input is passed to Core.
This is v2 schema/OpenAPI export logic, not the v3 declaration generator. It exports v2 metadata/result/validation/diagnostic contracts and explicitly says Core owns measurement/4PL.
